free_tier.stated: Virtually unlimited; billed per GB-month, Paris (eu-west-par) only

retention.stated: `retention-clamped`: 180-day minimum storage billed per object, verified on OVH's own page

egress.terms: Free. OVH product page verbatim: "No more egress fees on OVHcloud Object Storage as of 1/1/26". Retrieval is charged separately at EUR 0.005/GB (= EUR 5/TB) at restore time.

tooling: AWS CLI, rclone, any S3 SDK; lifecycle rules supported
limits_note: `retention-clamped`: 180-day minimum storage billed per object, verified on OVH's own page. Tape-backed (11 nines durability, 99.9% SLA); restore of hundreds of TB can take up to 48 hours; retrieval fee EUR 5/TB; restoring also re-incurs Standard-class storage cost while the object is accessible.
reliability_note: Tape robot restores are minutes-to-hours for TB-scale and up to 48 h at hundreds of TB — unusable as a serving origin, correct as cold archive.

evidence.proved: "No more egress fees on OVHcloud Object Storage as of 1/1/26"; storage classes incl. One-Zone, Local Zone
"Minimum storage billed: 180 days; Retrieval fee: Yes; Magnetic tapes; Durability: 11 nines; SLA 99.9%" and restore-time FAQ (max 48 h at hundreds of TB)
Cold Archive EUR 0.00128/GB/month (derived from api.ovh.com catalog addon coldarchive.archive.hour.consumption x 730 h), retrieval EUR 0.005/GB, Paris only, verified 2026-10-20
